patch.value: Adopt pm-cli 2026.7.26 typed authoring contracts and remove the any-cast defineExtension shim

Replace the forced-any defineExtension shim with a locally declared identity helper constrained by the SDK ExtensionModule contract, and type activate with the real ExtensionApi. Keeps the package's dependency on @unbrained/pm-cli type-only so no runtime module edge is introduced.
No any casts remain in the extension definition path; activate is typed with the real ExtensionApi; Dependency on @unbrained/pm-cli stays type-only at runtime; typecheck and the full test suite pass
